heading_content.title: We'd love to hear from you
heading_content.paragraph: Questions about a tour, a group booking, or something else? Our Florence-based team usually replies within 24 hours.

faqs.title: How quickly will I get a reply?
faqs.content: Our Florence-based team typically responds to messages, emails, and WhatsApp within 24 hours, and often much sooner during business hours.

faqs.title: Can I request a private or custom tour?
faqs.content: Yes — mention it in your message and we will put together a private walk tailored to your interests, group size, and schedule.

faqs.title: What's your cancellation policy?
faqs.content: Most tours offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start time. Check your specific tour listing for full details.

faqs.title: Do you offer group discounts?
faqs.content: We offer special rates for larger groups and schools. Send us your group size and dates and we will get back to you with a quote.

faqs.title: Which languages do your guides speak?
faqs.content: Our guides lead tours in English, Italian, and several other languages — let us know your preference when you reach out.

fill_out_the_form: Fill out the form and we'll get back to you as soon as possible — usually within one business day.
